message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk" on Thursday morning, Yuriko provided feedback on the demo website, which showcased progress and received positive feedback from Li Hua. Specifically, Yuriko mentioned that she appreciated the color scheme of the website, describing it as "perfect" and reflecting the gentle vibe of her studio. She expressed enthusiasm about adding a section for community outreach programs, which she believed would effectively highlight the impact of her work. Additionally, Yuriko suggested including details about the programs she offers and testimonials from participants, as well as including some photos from past events. Li Hua responded positively to Yuriko's comments, indicating that he thought the color scheme was excellent and that she had indeed captured the right aesthetic for the studio. He was enthusiastic about adding a community outreach section and noted that Yuriko's suggestion of including testimonials and photos would be beneficial. Li Hua also mentioned that he would help Yuriko brainstorm ideas for the layout and presentation of the feedback section, emphasizing his intention to ensure that it would make the website shine.
